topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: The rain hadn't let up when I got the call. Some uppity new homeowner claiming they found a room no one knew about in a fixer-upper on Maple. Like they stumbled into a B-movie. The way they were talking, you'd think they found the Holland Tunnel. I told them I'd take the case, but I didn’t mention the sick feeling that twisted when they described the heavy door, cold to the touch, deep in the house they thought they knew. Money can buy a lot, but it can’t always tell you when to stop digging.
